id: title:jabahamondes:guard missing revenue column in bing report

review.posthog_relevance: Allows Bing Ads warehouse ingestion to complete when the warehouse lacks the revenue column, preventing a missing-field failure.
review.reason: The production implementation P1.F3.H1 is absent, but P1.F2.H1 explicitly adds a runtime check for the missing revenue column and returns a constant zero. This demonstrates a bounded, substantive improvement: it changes the behavior of the Bing Ads adapter from failing to completing gracefully.
